svg.title: The Mersenne subsum set of Erdős #257 on the number line from 0 to 1.6067: its covers at depths 1 to 7 as rows of hatched bars, the sums without the exponent 1 in red on the left, the same set moved by 1 in blue on the right, each of measure one half. A loupe enlarges the deepest row 4096 times, where two bars that look joined are separated by a gap.
